configuration.hooks: no shell-command hooks. Extension surface is a JS/TS plugin: project .opencode/plugin/*.{ts,js} or .opencode/plugins/, global ~/.config/opencode/plugin(s)/, or npm packages in opencode.json "plugin". A plugin is an async function receiving {client, project, worktree, directory, experimental_workspace, serverUrl, $ (Bun shell)} and returning a Hooks object. The probe also saw 45 plugin.added events for built-in plugins.
configuration.trust: measured: none; the project plugin loaded in a fresh directory
configuration.headless: measured: opencode run '<prompt>' --format json < /dev/null emits one JSON event per line (tool parts with state {status, input, output|error}, text parts). Default permissions ran bash and write without a prompt (permission.ask never fired).
configuration.mcp: documented: "mcp" in opencode.json (project or ~/.config/opencode); pmcp already projects it. Not exercised.

permission.fires: not in this run (no permission prompt)

stop.notes: an event only; nothing can hold the turn open. pmcp maps it to stop for the registry

session_end.notes: no dedicated event; dispose() on plugin shutdown

deny.shape: throw new Error(reason) in tool.execute.before; the tool part ends status error with the message, and the model reads it

context.notes: the model quoted the system token and both after-tool tokens; a before-tool note has no channel except mutating args

deferred.before_tool: after_tool (appended to the tool output); V2 opencode-context-before-cc5abe06

stop_context.notes: no blocking stop hook; session.idle is observe-only

shell_hook.notes: the plugin spawned a hook recorder from tool.execute.before three times (status 0, stdout '{}'). A pmcp adapter can be a small generated plugin that spawns hook.mjs with a normalized payload and maps a deny to a throw.

timeouts: none documented; plugin hooks are awaited in-process

context.notes: pause, broadcast and shared_checkout notices reached the model; held context arrived at the next delivering event

prompt_context.notes: opencode stores no system prompt; context-prompt cannot show delivery. The plugin fix 35f3c77 is shown live by the system probes: before it the main model replied NONE, after it the model repeated the token.
